description: The plot illustrates how ASR varies across a set of categorical x-axis items for three series labeled “start,” “random,” and “end.” The x-axis is categorical (linear placement of categories) with tick labels including “c,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletic,” spanning from the leftmost category “c” to the rightmost “athletic.” The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” shown on a linear scale with visible tick labels at approximately 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9 (about 0.1 increments), and the plotted values extend from just above 0.5 up to near 1.0. The “start” line is teal with small circular markers and a solid stroke; it begins around 0.78 at “c,” drops to about 0.53 at “bb,” jumps to about 0.94 at “WNBA,” then stays around 0.90–0.95 through “ESPN” and “NHL,” rises to roughly 0.97 at “FIFA,” and ends near 0.98 at “athletic.” The “random” line is orange with x-shaped markers and a solid stroke; it starts near 0.67 at “c,” declines to about 0.55 at “bb,” rises to about 0.93 at “WNBA,” dips to about 0.81 at “ESPN,” increases through about 0.86 at “NHL” to around 0.96 at “FIFA,” and finishes around 0.95–0.96 at “athletic.” The “end” line is purple with circular markers and a solid stroke; it starts around 0.77 at “c,” drops to about 0.61 at “bb,” rises to about 0.93 at “WNBA,” dips to about 0.82 at “ESPN,” peaks around 0.95 at the next category, dips slightly near “NHL,” reaches its highest point near 0.99 at “FIFA,” and then decreases to roughly 0.95 by “athletic.”
